subject: Postcall: audit artifacts, retention exception & artifact roadmap for LedgerEdge pilot
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@ledgeredge.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@ledgeredge.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Intro call — audit artifacts & retention constraints (post-call recap)

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Below is a concise recap of the problems you flagged, what success looks like, and proposed next steps. Please confirm or correct anything I’ve mis-stated.

Summary of pain points you shared
- Retention gap: your legal team requires a 7-year retention baseline for certain transaction logs; our current default retention for audit logs is 90 days for hosted customers.
- Audit evidence: LedgerEdge needs pen test reports (full report + methodology), SOC 2 Type II scope statement, and system-generated immutable audit logs for a subset of administrative actions.
- DPA language: you’ll need a clause clarifying log ownership and deletion windows for co-mingled logs (pilot uses shared infra).
- Deletion / eDiscovery: ability to slice logs by tenant and export chain-of-custody for regulatory requests.

What success looks like for the pilot (mutual goal)
- A scoped pilot contract that lists specific artifact commits (pen test report, SOC2 scope, audit-log retention profile, DPA addendum) within 30 days of SOW start.
- A mapped plan to provide tenant-level exports and retention exceptions for the pilot environment.

Proposed next steps (owners & timeline)
1) Redwood to share initial artifact checklist and call recording — Evelyn (today, attached).
2) LedgerEdge to confirm which log classes must be retained 7 years vs. 90–365d for analytics — Alex (by 2027-04-22).
3) Redwood Security to surface pen test cadence and provide recent sample report (redacted) — Rishi (by 2027-04-23).
4) Legal: draft DPA addendum covering retention/deletion responsibilities for pilot — Aditya (draft by 2027-04-23).
5) Follow-up technical sync to review feasibility for tenant-level exports and chain-of-custody — Laura to schedule (target week of 2027-04-26).

Attachments included: call-recording-20270418.mp3 (audio), ledgeredge-artifact-checklist-v1.xlsx (artifact matrix).

Open questions for you
- Are there specific compliance frameworks beyond SOC 2 (e.g., PCI in scope for transaction telemetry)?
- Does LedgerEdge require on-prem retention for the 7-year dataset or will a hosted, encrypted archive with access controls be acceptable?

If that list looks right I’ll kick off the internal owners and get the checklist populated with expected artifact formats (PDF, CSV exports, raw logs) and acceptable redaction levels. Thanks again — talk soon.

--
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@ledgeredge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@ledgeredge.com>, security@ledgeredge.com
Date: 2027-04-18T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Intro call — audit artifacts & retention constraints (post-call recap)

Evelyn — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming the call notes are accurate from our side. A few clarifications:
- For the pilot we can scope a subset of transaction logs for 7-year retention (payment settlement records and dispute receipts). Other telemetry (metrics/traces) can live on the 90–365d window.
- We’ll accept hosted encrypted archive provided there’s documented access controls and an export mechanism for legal holds.
- Pen test: we have an internal external pentest scheduled Q2; we can share last year’s external report (redacted) by EOD 4/22.

I’ve looped in security@ledgeredge.com for any technical questions — Priya will be the primary security contact for artifact intake.

Regards,
Alex
Director, Platform Ops — LedgerEdge

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@ledgeredge.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@ledgeredge.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Postcall: audit artifacts, retention exception & artifact roadmap for LedgerEdge pilot

Evelyn — I’ll take point on scheduling the technical follow-up (tenant-level export feasibility). Actions I’m logging:
- Schedule 60m tech deep-dive (engineers + security) — target 2027-04-27.
- Create matrix mapping 'log class' -> 'retention options' (immutable archive, cold storage, deletion windows) and highlight which require a DPA exception.
- Coordinate with infra to validate whether we can attach per-tenant retention policies in the pilot (likely via a retention-tag + export job).

Aditya — please start a DPA addendum draft that includes: retention windows by log class, chain-of-custody export SLA (RTO/RPO for export), and any audit access guarantees. I’ve added a stub link to the Drive where we’ll keep versions: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/ledgeredge/dpa-draft.

Rishi — can you pull the most recent redacted pen test sample and SOC 2 scope statement (we have these on the security drive) so we can attach them to the artifact checklist?

I’ll update the artifact checklist spreadsheet with the initial mapping and expected formats.

--
Laura Bennett
Manager, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@ledgeredge.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@ledgeredge.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Postcall: audit artifacts, retention exception & artifact roadmap for LedgerEdge pilot

Perfect — thanks Alex & Priya. Confirming next milestones:
- LedgerEdge to send the redacted pen test by 2027-04-22.
- Redwood to deliver populated artifact checklist + sample SOC 2 scope by 2027-04-23.
- Tech deep-dive scheduled by Laura for the week of 2027-04-26; calendar invite to follow.

I’ll also open a HubSpot milestone (HS-LE-000452) to track delivery and will attach the checklist and artifacts as they arrive. If anything changes on your end (different retention classes or an accelerated timeline), please let me know.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

--
Evelyn
